chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Ch. 298: The Flame Manipulation Art
chapter_meta_description: Han Li commissions a low-level rogue Daoist to spy on the Wang household and in return acquires a little self-written manual that may change how he casts spells forever.
og_title: RMJI Ch. 298 — The Priest Who Sold a Conceptual Gem for Pills
og_description: A rogue cultivator’s self-taught flame art reveals a hidden path to spell flexibility. Han Li pays for it with Yellow Dragon Pills—and a surveillance contract.
twitter_title: RMJI 298: How a Rogue Priest’s Parchment Became Han Li’s Spell Upgrade
twitter_description: An old Daoist trades his life’s work—the Flame Manipulation Art—for breakthrough pills. Han Li walks away with a blueprint for flexible spellcasting.

lore_anchors.definition: A self-created manual by a rogue Daoist, focused on flexible application and mid-cast reshaping of flame spells, rather than rigid orthodox casting.
A basic fire-element cultivation technique found by the Daoist on a dying cultivator; the foundation of his meager cultivation.
A Qi Condensation–grade pill effective for cultivators below layer ten; used to break through early bottlenecks.
